nodes.description: Public token name string set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the constructor.
Public token decimals (9).
Private privileged address hardcoded to 0x8799CD8fdfD3865F6c1D49220CF4a1EF40e631bC; gates the real transfer path in transferFrom.
Public total supply, minted to msg.sender in the constructor.
Private mapping of holder balances, mutated by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Private nested mapping of allowances, written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Constructor: sets metadata, mints _totalSupply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Reads balances[tokenOwner].
Reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no zero-address or return-value checks.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Owner-gated transfer: only succeeds in mutating balances when from == _owner, otherwise silently performs no-op arithmetic with 0 and returns true.
Overflow-checked addition used by transfer and transferFrom.
Underflow-checked subtraction used by transfer and transferFrom.
Overflow-checked multiplication inherited from SafeMath; unused by ShihtzuInu.
Zero-checked division inherited from SafeMath; unused by ShihtzuInu.
Caller-controlled address used as balance/allowance owner in constructor, approve, transfer and transferFrom.
Authorization branch 'if (from == _owner)' decides whether balances actually move; non-owner transfers silently no-op while still returning true (broken access control / honeypot path).
Allowance is decremented via safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) without any explicit require on the allowance or on msg.sender authorization, so the check relies purely on arithmetic revert.
Entire _totalSupply is assigned to the deployer msg.sender with no ownership or supply-cap control.
Parameter spender of approve: allowance beneficiary.
Parameter tokens of approve: allowance amount.
Parameter to of transfer: recipient address.
Parameter tokens of transfer: amount moved.
Parameter from of transferFrom: source address compared against _owner.
Parameter to of transferFrom: recipient address.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom: amount moved and allowance deducted.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf: queried holder address.

edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the owner slot of allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
msg.sender is the debited balance holder in transfer.
msg.sender indexes allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
msg.sender receives the initial supply in the constructor.
Caller-controlled msg.sender is the only spender able to drive the owner-gated branch selection logic.
Caller-controlled msg.sender determines which allowance entry is decremented without an explicit authorization check.
spender is written into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
tokens is stored as the approved allowance amount.
approve writes to the allowed allowance mapping.
'to' is credited in balances[to] by transfer.
tokens is the amount subtracted and added in transfer.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
'from' is compared to _owner and used as the balance source in transferFrom.
'to' is the credited address in transferFrom.
tokens is the amount moved and the allowance decrement in transferFrom.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances and allowed entries.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom control flow branches on the from == _owner authorization gate.
transferFrom reaches the unchecked allowance deduction operation.
The owner-gated branch decides whether balances state is actually rewritten or left untouched.
The unchecked deduction writes the allowed allowance mapping.
The hardcoded _owner state variable is the sole condition selecting the privileged transfer path.
The constructor performs the unrestricted initial mint operation.
The mint writes balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply without any authorization control.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner indexes the balances lookup in balanceOf.
